papers.title: The bone-implant interface of dental implants in humans on the atomic scale.
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: Osseointegration of dental implants occurs on a hierarchy of length scales down to the atomic level. A deeper understanding of the complex processes that take place at the surface of an implant on the smallest scale is of interest for the development of improved biomaterials. To date, transmission electron microscopy (TEM) has been utilized for examination of the bone-implant interface, providing details on the nanometer level. In this study we show that TEM imaging can be complemented with atom probe tomography (APT) to reveal the chemical composition of a Ti-based dental implant in a human jaw on the atomic level of resolution. As the atom probe technique has equal sensitivity for all elements, it allows for 3 dimensional characterizations of osseointegrated interfaces with unprecedented resolution. The APT reconstructions reveal a Ca-enriched zone in the immediate vicinity of the implant surface. A surface oxide of some 5nm thickness was measured on the titanium implant, with a sub-stoichiometric composition with respect to TiO2. Minor incorporation of Ca into the thin oxide film was also evident. We conclude that the APT technique is capable of revealing chemical information from the bone-implant interface in 3D with unprecedented resolution, thus providing important insights into the mechanisms behind osseointegration. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE: Osseointegration of dental implants occurs on a hierarchy of length scales down to the atomic level. A deeper understanding of the complex processes that take place at the surface of an implant on the smallest scale is of interest for the development of improved biomaterials. To date, transmission electron microscopy (TEM) has been utilized for examination of the bone-implant interface, providing details on the nanometer level. In this study we show that TEM imaging can be complemented with atom probe tomography (APT) to reveal the chemical composition of a Ti-based dental implant in a human jaw on the atomic level of resolution. Correlative microscopy ensures the accuracy of APT reconstructions and helps provide both chemical and structural information of the bone-implant interface on the smallest of length scales.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究牙种植体的骨-种植体界面原子级结构，与髋关节植入物应力遮挡和微动分析无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress/strain in Gruen zones, report micromotion, or compare intact vs implanted femur; it focuses on atomic-scale chemical characterization of dental implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示牙种植体骨整合在原子尺度的化学机制。
summary_zh.method: 使用透射电镜和原子探针断层扫描分析人类颌骨中的钛种植体界面。
summary_zh.result: 发现种植体表面存在钙富集区和约5nm的亚化学计量氧化钛层。
summary_zh.validation: 通过关联显微术验证原子探针重构的准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the atomic-scale chemical mechanisms of osseointegration for dental implants.
summary_en.method: Transmission electron microscopy and atom probe tomography were applied to characterize the bone-implant interface of a titanium dental implant in a human jaw.
summary_en.result: A calcium-enriched zone and a substoichiometric titanium oxide layer of about 5 nm were observed at the implant surface.
summary_en.validation: Correlative microscopy confirmed the accuracy of atom probe reconstructions, providing both chemical and structural information.

papers.title: Clinical application of information-motivation-behavioral skills model nursing after total hip arthroplasty
papers.abstract:
Objective
To design a continuing nursing intervention program for post-operation rehabilitation exercise of total hip arthroplasty based on information-motivation-behavioral skills (IMB) model, and to study the clinical effect of the program applied in rehabilitation nursing of patients after total hip arthroplasty.


Methods
A total of 60 patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty were randomly divided into intervention group and control group, 30 patients in each group. The intervention group received conventional nursing care combined with IMB continuing nursing intervention program, while control group received conventional nursing care only. The schedule attainment of rehabilitation exercise program, and Harris hip score 1 week, 1 month, and 3 months after operation were compared between two groups.


Results
The completion rate of rehabilitation exercise program in intervention group was significantly higher than that in control group (93.3% vs.73.3%), with statistically significant difference (P<0.05). Harris hip score 1 week, 1 month after operation in intervention group were higher than those in control group [(49.73±4.90) vs.(46.63±4.35), (71.30±5.22) vs.(68.90±4.42)], with statistically significant differences (P=0.010, 0.014); there was no statistically significant difference in Harris hip score between two groups 3 months after operation [(83.20±5.51) vs.(81.30±5.25), P=0.185].


Conclusion
The nursing program based on IMB model can improve the compliance of rehabilitation exercise after total hip arthroplasty, and facilitate early functional rehabilitation after total hip arthroplasty.


Key words: 
Total hip arthroplasty; Information-motivation-behavioral skills model; Nursing intervention; Hip function

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为全髋关节置换术后护理干预的临床研究，不涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物力学分析，与用户研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical nursing study; it does not quantify femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, contact mechanics, or any FEA/mechanical analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计基于IMB模型的延续护理方案以提高全髋关节置换术后康复锻炼依从性
summary_zh.method: 将60例患者随机分组，对照组常规护理，干预组加IMB延续护理，比较康复锻炼完成率和Harris评分
summary_zh.result: 干预组康复锻炼完成率显著高于对照组，术后1周和1个月Harris评分更高，但3个月无显著差异

summary_en.motivation: To develop a continuing nursing intervention based on the IMB model to improve rehabilitation exercise compliance after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Sixty patients were randomized; the intervention group received additional IMB-based care; rehabilitation compliance and Harris scores were compared.
summary_en.result: The intervention group had significantly higher exercise compliance and better early Harris scores, but no difference at 3 months.
